parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the SAE application.

parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the SAE application.

parameters.name: AuthVersion
parameters.description:
The edition of Security Center. Valid values:

*   **6**: Anti-virus.
*   **5**: Advanced.
*   **3**: Enterprise.
*   **7**: Ultimate.
*   **10**: Value-added Plan.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryUid
parameters.description: The UID of the resource directory.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-machine-apps --app-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --resource-directory-uid 123456 --app-id 5b41f4bf-349f-4263-89b1-9234c0340000 --app-name agent-commprice-shop --auth-version 7 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
